newsitem.title: CHINA: World Bank in $120 mln agriculture loan in China.
newsitem.headline: World Bank in $120 mln agriculture loan in China.

text.p: The World Bank said on Friday it had approved a $120 million loan for an agricultural development project to boost rural employment and market-oriented enterprise development in northeast China.

The total cost of the project in Heilongjiang province is estimated at $239.8 million, of which 50 percent will be financed by the World Bank loan. The provincial government will contribute $63.8 million and the project beneficiaries will contribute the rest, the bank said.

The project will benefit some 2.75 million families by expanding livestock and aquaculture production and improving crop and livestock processing, it said. The project is intended to slow rural migration to urban areas, it said.
